items.zh: 帧率检测下线：由于特殊原因，目前无法继续提供帧率检测功能，悬浮 OSD、游戏运行报告及“游戏性能”页面同步下线。
items.en: Frame-rate monitoring is discontinued: due to special circumstances, we can no longer provide this feature at present. The OSD, game run reports and Game performance page have also been removed.

items.zh: 清理旧监测设置；仅自动卸载经确认由 Pavise 安装的 RTSS，用户自行安装的版本不受影响，已有个人数据保留。
items.en: Retired monitoring preferences are cleared. Only an RTSS installation confirmed as installed by Pavise is automatically uninstalled; independently installed copies and existing personal data are kept.

items.zh: 重做托管电源：按 CPU 架构、设备类型及智能/竞技模式自动匹配完整电源方案，替代旧参数拼接方式。
items.en: Reworked managed power to select complete power plans automatically by CPU architecture, device type and Smart or Competitive mode, replacing the previous parameter-by-parameter template.

items.zh: 导入电源方案时保留本机屏幕、睡眠、合盖等日常设置及全部电池设置；非对称缓存 X3D 保留停泊与调度保护。
items.en: Imported power plans retain local display, sleep, lid and other daily-use preferences and all battery settings. Asymmetric-cache X3D systems retain parking and scheduling safeguards.

items.zh: 移除“掌机适配”开关及型号识别，掌机按 CPU 与核心结构自动匹配电源计划；智能使用通用计划，普通同构 AMD 竞技使用 AMD 低延迟，混合核心 AMD 使用通用计划。
items.en: Removed the handheld adaptation switch and model detection. Handhelds now follow CPU and core-topology rules: Smart uses the universal plan, Competitive uses AMD Low Latency on ordinary homogeneous AMD CPUs, and mixed-core AMD CPUs use the universal plan.

items.zh: Threadripper、Xeon、EPYC 等工作站及多处理器组/多插槽设备，在智能和竞技模式下均使用通用电源计划。
items.en: Threadripper, Xeon, EPYC and other workstations, along with multi-group/socket systems, now use the universal power plan in both Smart and Competitive modes.

items.zh: 统一电源计划名称，按 CPU 类型与用途标识，并调整常规设置布局。
items.en: Standardized power-plan names by CPU type and purpose and adjusted the General settings layout.

items.zh: 移除电源每秒参数巡检、自动修复及隐式“最佳性能”覆盖，保留计划切换与退局恢复。
items.en: Removed per-second power-parameter inspection, automatic repair and implicit Best performance overlay activation. Plan switching and restoration after games remain.

items.zh: 实验室 CPU 空闲设置改为在电源方案生效后应用；关闭时恢复当前方案原值，方案已包含设置时明确提示。
items.en: Lab CPU idle settings now apply after the power plan. Turning them off restores that plan's original values, with a clear notice when the plan already includes the requested setting.

items.zh: 切换电源方案、调整 CPU 空闲策略或发现外部空闲设置修改时，EPP 功耗让路先恢复再重新验证，避免沿用旧基准。
items.en: EPP power yielding is restored and re-evaluated when the power plan or CPU idle policy changes, or an external idle-setting change is detected, avoiding reuse of the previous baseline.

items.zh: 概览新增本局守护统计，显示已压制进程与已暂停服务数量；只计确认生效项，复用现有扫描，不额外扫描进程。
items.en: Overview now shows this session's suppressed-process and paused-service counts, using confirmed actions and existing scan results without extra process scans.

items.zh: 新增软件内更新：在“关于 → 检查与更新”下载，显示进度，签名校验后原位替换；保留游戏库、白名单、偏好及自启动设置。
items.en: Added in-app updates under About → Check for updates, with progress, signature verification and in-place EXE replacement. Game libraries, whitelist, preferences and autostart settings are retained.

items.zh: 更新前需先退出游戏；下载与校验可取消，安装时限制退出；失败可在同窗转夸克/GitHub 手动下载。3.2.0.1 及更早版本需先手动升级一次。
items.en: Leave the game before updating. Download and verification can be cancelled; exiting is restricted during installation. Failures offer Quark/GitHub manual downloads in the same dialog. Version 3.2.0.1 and earlier require a one-time manual upgrade.

items.zh: 修复更新弹窗未居中及窄窗口策略菜单的滚动与排列问题；移除无效最大化按钮。
items.en: Fixed update-dialog centering and strategy-menu scrolling and layout in narrow windows; removed the non-functional maximize button.

items.zh: 修复游戏库与白名单运行列表漏掉最小化、托盘应用的问题；白名单支持聊天软件、浏览器和开发工具，空列表不再误提示全部已加入白名单。
items.en: Fixed missing minimized and tray apps in the library and whitelist running-program lists. Whitelist discovery includes chat apps, browsers and development tools; empty results no longer incorrectly claim that every app is already whitelisted.
